sn35.133:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā udāyī kāmaṇḍāyaṃ viharati todeyyassa brāhmaṇassa ambavane.
sn35.133:1.2: atha kho verahaccānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā antevāsī māṇavako yenāyasmā udāyī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā udāyinā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn35.133:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn35.133:1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ māṇavakaṃ āyasmā udāyī dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
sn35.133:1.5: atha kho so māṇavako āyasmatā udāyinā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā yena verahaccānigottā brāhmaṇī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā verahaccānigottaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ etadavoca:
sn35.133:1.7: samaṇo udāyī dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ, sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetīti.
sn35.133:2.1: tena hi tvaṃ māṇavaka, mama vacanena samaṇaṃ udāyiṃ nimantehi svātanāya bhattenāti.
sn35.133:2.2: evaṃ bhotīti kho so māṇavako verahaccānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā paṭissutvā yenāyasmā udāyī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
sn35.133:2.3: adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ udāyi amhākaṃ ācariyabhariyāya verahaccānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā svātanāya bhattanti.
sn35.133:2.5: atha kho āyasmā udāyī tassā rattiyā accayena pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena verahaccānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn35.133:2.6: atha kho verahaccānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
sn35.133:2.7: atha kho verahaccānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ pādukā ārohitvā ucce āsane nisīditvā sīsaṃ oguṇṭhitā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
sn35.133:2.9: bhavissati bhagini samayoti vatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkami.
sn35.133:3.1: dutiyampi kho so māṇavako yenāyasmā udāyī tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā udāyinā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn35.133:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn35.133:3.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ māṇavakaṃ āyasmā udāyī dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi, samādapesi, samuttejesi, sampahaṃsesi.
sn35.133:3.4: dutiyampi kho so māṇavako āyasmatā udāyinā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā yena verahaccānigottā brāhmaṇī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā verahaccānigottaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ etadavoca:
sn35.133:3.6: samaṇo udāyī dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetīti.
sn35.133:4.1: evamevaṃ pana tvaṃ māṇavaka samaṇassa udāyissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsasi.
sn35.133:4.2: samaṇo panudāyī bhaṇa samaṇa dhammanti vutto samāno bhavissati bhagini samayoti vatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pakkantoti.
sn35.133:4.3: tathā hi pana tvaṃ bhoti pādukā ārohitvā ucce āsane nisīditvā sīsaṃ oguṇṭhitā etadavoca:
sn35.133:4.6: tena hi tvaṃ māṇavaka, mama vacanena samaṇaṃ udāyiṃ nimantehi svātanāya bhattenāti.
sn35.133:4.7: evaṃ bhotīti kho so māṇavako verahaccānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā paṭissutvā yenāyasmā udāyī tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
sn35.133:4.8: adhivāsesi kira bhavaṃ udāyī amhākaṃ ācariyabhariyāya verahaccānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā svātanāya bhattanti.
sn35.133:5.1: atha kho āyasmā udāyī tassā rattiyā accayena pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena verahaccānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn35.133:5.2: atha kho verahaccānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi, sampavāresi.
sn35.133:5.3: atha kho verahaccānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ pādukā oruhitvā nīce āsane nisīditvā sīsaṃ vivaritvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
sn35.133:5.4: kisminnu kho bhante, sati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti? kismiṃ asati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ na paññāpentīti?
sn35.133:6.1: cakkhusmiṃ kho bhagini sati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ paññāpenti, cakkhusmiṃ asati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ na paññāpenti …pe…
sn35.133:6.2: jivhāya asati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ na paññāpenti kāyasmiṃ …pe…
sn35.133:6.3: manasmiṃ sati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ na paññāpentīti.
sn35.133:7.1: evaṃ vutte verahaccānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca:
sn35.133:7.3: seyyathāpi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evamevaṃ ayyena udāyinā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn35.133:7.4: esāhaṃ ayya udāyi taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn35.133:7.5: upāsikaṃ maṃ ayyo udāyī dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
